name: UTS Student Legal Service
summary: Free legal advice for enrolled UTS students on tenancy, employment, traffic, consumer, debt and other matters.
key: Free legal advice for all students currently enrolled at UTS.
how: Email studentlegalservice@uts.edu.au, call 02 9514 2484 or drop in to Tower Building 1, level 5
catches: No advice on visa or migration matters or issues against UTS

evidence.quote: All students currently enrolled at UTS have access to free legal advice.
